hybrid.reference: the truth's exact top 100 as the vector leg, vellev's keyword search as the keyword leg, fused by vellev's own fusion (vellev_index::fusion::fuse) at alpha 0.75 with relative scores; fused in f32 from f64 cosines, so fused scores within about 1e-6 may swap at the 10th place

memory.note: anon is memory.stat anon, the engine's own; the file cache is reported apart; memory.peak includes the cache

notes.postgres: runs on the same CPUs as vellev, within the same memory (512 MiB of it), and its memory is counted with vellev's

opened.state: empty local disk (its cache directory emptied, the store kept) and the OS page cache dropped

settings.default_oversample: the node's own, no oversample asked

hybrid.reference: Weaviate's own hybrid (alpha 0.75, relativeScoreFusion) with ef set to the number of rows: near-exhaustive, not proven exact

memory.note: anon is memory.stat anon, the engine's own; the file cache is reported apart; memory.peak includes the cache

notes.settled: the vector queue of every shard empty and its indexing READY; Weaviate exposes no signal for compaction, so compaction is not waited for

opened.state: the OS page cache dropped (Weaviate keeps its data on the local disk alone, so there is no emptier state)

many_tenants.idle_tenant_open: not published: Weaviate has no equivalent of letting a tenant go once idle (its tenants go cold only when told), so the same event cannot be measured on both sides (§3e)
many_tenants.settings: vellev lets a tenant go after 10 minutes idle (VELLEV_TENANT_IDLE_SECS=600); Weaviate runs with ASYNC_INDEXING=true, which its dynamic index needs
